Bahrain Electricity and Water Bill Calculator

Enter your monthly electricity and water use from your bill or meter to see the bill at Resolution 2 of 2025 tariffs, in force since 1 January 2026.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your bill

Leave at zero if the landlord pays water.
Optional: the rate depends on the property and rent.

Bahrain electricity tariff from 1 January 2026 (fils per kWh)

The citizens' 5,001–7,000 slab was 32 fils in the original resolution; the Cabinet cut it to 16 fils on 2 February 2026 for bills issued from 1 January. The unsubsidised rate rose from 29 to 32 fils.

Water tariff (fils per m³)

Above 100 m³775775

Other items on the bill

  • Fixed fee: BD 1 a month per electricity account and BD 1 per water account (Article 9).
  • VAT: already included in the tariffs (Article 8).
  • Wastewater: 20% of the water charge for non-Bahrainis, multi-account holders and non-residential users; a citizen's first home is exempt.
  • Municipality: varies with the property and rent, so enter it from your bill if it appears.

Worked examples

An expat flat using 1,500 kWh and 20 m³: electricity 1,500 × 0.032 = BD 48, water 20 × 0.775 = 15.500, two fixed fees 2 and wastewater 3.100, a total of BD 68.600.

A citizen's villa (first home) using 5,000 kWh and 60 m³: electricity (3,000 × 0.003) + (2,000 × 0.009) = BD 27, water 1.500 and fixed fees 2, a total of BD 30.500. At 7,500 kWh in summer, electricity becomes BD 75.

On 13 October 2026 Parliament unanimously backed an urgent proposal to restore the previous subsidised tariffs for first homes; it went to the government and has not been adopted. We will update the calculator if the tariff changes.

Frequently asked questions

What is the electricity tariff in Bahrain in 2026?

For a citizen's first home with one account: 3 fils per kWh up to 3,000, 9 fils up to 5,000, 16 fils up to 7,000 and 32 fils above. Non-Bahrainis and multi-account holders pay 32 fils for all use. Prices include VAT.

What is the water tariff in Bahrain in 2026?

For a citizen's first home: 25 fils per m³ up to 60, 80 fils up to 100 and 775 fils above. Non-Bahrainis, multi-account holders and non-residential users pay 775 fils per m³.

Does the EWA tariff include VAT?

Yes. Article 8 of Resolution 2 of 2025 says the tariffs include the applicable VAT, so nothing is added on top.

What is the bill for an expat flat using 1,500 kWh and 20 m³?

BD 68.600: electricity 48, water 15.500, two fixed fees 2 and wastewater 3.100, before municipality fees.
